title: Manchester United make offer worth up to £51.4m for Atalanta’s Rasmus Højlund
trail: Manchester United have made a verbal offer that could be worth €60m (£51.4m) for Rasmus Højlund as they attempt to beat Paris Saint-Germain to the signing of the striker from Atalanta
body: Manchester United have made a verbal offer that could be worth €60m (£51.4m) for Rasmus Højlund as they attempt to beat Paris Saint-Germain to the signing of the striker from Atalanta. Højlund has emerged as United’s key target as they attempt to strengthen their attacking options and talks with the Italian club over the 20-year-old have already begun. It is understood that the offer for the Denmark striker is an initial €50m plus another €10m in bonuses, although Atalanta have previously indicated they would hold out for £70m despite Højlund’s relative lack of experience. He registered eight goals and two assists in 31 league games last season after moving to Serie A from Austrian side Sturm Graz last summer. PSG are also understood to be interested in Højlund as they search for a potential replacement for Kylian Mbappé but, unlike United, they have yet to agree personal terms. Højlund is believed to have already indicated his desire to leave this summer. Eintracht Frankfurt’s Randal Kolo Muani is also a player of firm interest for Erik ten Hag, while United have also been linked with Ajax forward Mohammed Kudus.
